facts.value: Independent telecom regulator for consumer rights, competition, licensing, spectrum, market oversight, and service-provider complaint escalation. Complaint domains encoded for routing: mobile_billing_or_regulatory_complaint, telecom_consumer_rights, operator_escalation, quality_of_service, false_billing.

Not responsible for / boundary conditions: direct_fixed_network_faults(use_OGERO_first); electricity; roads; water; emergency_response; postal_services; mobile_billing_roaming_or_operator_consumer_dispute; Route instead to TRA when Mobile billing/regulatory disputes go to operator then TRA escalation.; routine_fixed_internet_or_landline_technical_fault; Route instead to OGERO when Use Ogero first for fixed technical faults unless provider failure/regulatory dispute is described.
facts.notes: Runtime cases may still require HITL when asset ownership, location, or public/private responsibility is ambiguous.

facts.value: Geographic scope: national. Do not route mobile network issues to Ogero. Use Alfa/Touch operator first when the provider is named and TRA for regulatory escalation after provider handling fails or regulatory context is clear. Use TRA for regulatory escalation when provider complaint failed or mobile billing dispute is clear.

Non-emergency phone: 1739; Website/form: https://www.tra.gov.lb/Protecting-your-rights-Resolving-your-complaints; HQ/address: TRA, Beirut; Email: info@tra.gov.lb; Special channels: consumer_protection_directorate=1739;provider_first_10_day_acknowledgment_20_day_escalation_signal; TRA Consumer Protection Directorate hotline: 1739; TRA online complaint page: https://www.tra.gov.lb/Protecting-your-rights-Resolving-your-complaints

Use after provider complaint is unresolved or for regulatory/billing consumer complaints. Fixed-line technical faults go to OGERO first.
